title: Most men's international goals in competitive matches (recorded scorers)
hook: Who has scored the most goals for his country?

source.name: martj42/international_results — goalscorers.csv
source.terms: Dataset licensed CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication) per the GitHub repository. Wikipedia cross-check text is CC BY-SA 4.0.
source.notes: Men's full internationals only (the dataset excludes Olympic, B-team, U-23 and league-select matches). Own goals excluded (936 rows); 44 rows with no scorer name skipped. Goal-level coverage is INCOMPLETE, especially in early decades: goals are only counted for matches present in the dataset's results table that also have scorer rows, so many players' totals are lower than official tallies. Friendlies carry NO scorer rows at all (0/52286 (0%) friendly goals have a scorer), so this is effectively competitive-match goals only; even there 47521/92072 (52%) of goals have a scorer (by decade from 1950: 1950s 48%, 1960s 44%, 1970s 36%, 1980s 47%, 1990s 51%, 2000s 59%, 2010s 55%, 2020s 66%). A player is identified by (scorer name, team) since the file has no player ids. Goals before 1950 are carried into the 1950 opening value. Newest goal in the file: 2026-07-19; 2025 is the last complete year, later goals are excluded from the series. Cross-check vs Wikipedia (revid 1378854116), comparing whole-file totals (incl. 2026 to date) to Wikipedia's to-date figures: Cristiano Ronaldo dataset 124 vs Wikipedia 146 (diff -22); Harry Kane dataset 75 vs Wikipedia 89 (diff -14); Robert Lewandowski dataset 69 vs Wikipedia 92 (diff -23). Wikipedia's top 3: Cristiano Ronaldo 146, Lionel Messi 125, Ali Daei 108. Discrepancies are left as the dataset records them.

crossCheck.name: Wikipedia: List of men's footballers with 50 or more international goals

caveat: NOT an official all-time ranking: the order differs from official career totals (Wikipedia #1 Cristiano Ronaldo is #1 here; Wikipedia #2 Lionel Messi is #5 here; Wikipedia #3 Ali Daei is #8 here). Present it as 'competitive goals in the open martj42 dataset' or do not use it for a 'who has the most' hook.
